title: Understanding Bootstrapping
text: Bootstrapping involves resampling with replacement from the sample data to create many simulated samples. This helps estimate the sampling distribution of a statistic.

title: Setting Up the Loop
text: To generate multiple bootstrapped samples, you need to use a loop. The range of the loop determines how many bootstrapped samples you will create.

title: Choosing the Number of Bootstraps
text: How many bootstrapped estimates do you want to generate?
